name: SmokeTermFloating
title: Smoke — follows the newest active value set
description: PAT-260 terminology pinning. Adults (p1-p4) form the denominator; the numerator needs a final Observation coded in the platform value set, referenced WITHOUT a version in the CQL.
cqlContent:
library SmokeTermFloating version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

include FHIRHelpers version '4.0.1' called FHIRHelpers

valueset "Smoke Term Pin Orders": 'https://smoke.example.tw/fhir/ValueSet/SmokeTermPinOrders'

parameter "Measurement Period" Interval<DateTime>

context Patient

define "Initial Population":
  AgeInYearsAt(end of "Measurement Period") >= 18

define "Denominator":
  "Initial Population"

define "Numerator":
  exists ([Observation: "Smoke Term Pin Orders"] O where O.status = 'final')
